summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 4, 2026. The filing merely confirms that shareholders approved five proposals previously described in the company's notice and proxy statement dated April 23, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, tender offer, or management change is disclosed; it is a standard periodic report of shareholder meeting outcomes with no deal terms or strategic action.
